_comment: exact_jets.py の selftest の歯を、 engine の要所を 1 つずつ壊した mutant で確かめる spec (claude-config の check-foil-teeth.py で回す)。 教科書の値 (定曲率空間・共形変換・Clifford を使わない微分幾何の恒等式) で engine を押さえていることの確認。

mutants.name: Leibniz の 2 階の交差項を 1 つ落とす
逆行列の 2 階微分の符号
Riemann の 2 次の項の符号
pairs: + einsum("mlr,lns->mnrs", G, G) - einsum("mls,lnr->mnrs", G, G))
- einsum("mlr,lns->mnrs", G, G) + einsum("mls,lnr->mnrs", G, G))
expect_fail: geometry: R^m_(nrs) = delta^m_r g_ns - delta^m_s g_nr on the unit constant-curvature space (D = 4, L)

mutants.name: riemann_sign を無視する
expect_fail: geometry: riemann_sign = -1 flips the scalar curvature (D = 4, L)

mutants.name: torsion の weight を無視する
1-form を eta で上げない
pairs: return einsum("ac,cbm->abm", eta_inv, Klow)   # raise the first index
expect_fail: random_frame_one_form: antisymmetric in the frame pair after lowering

mutants.name: Weyl 因子の 2 階微分から (d sigma)^2 を落とす
expect_fail: conformal: R' = lam^-2 (R - 2(D-1) box s - (D-1)(D-2) (d s)^2) (D = 4)
expect_pass: conformal: det e' = lam^D det e (D = 4)

mutants.name: box の Christoffel の項の符号
expect_fail: conformal: R' = lam^-2 (R - 2(D-1) box s - (D-1)(D-2) (d s)^2) (D = 4)
expect_pass: conformal: det e' = lam^D det e (D = 4)

mutants.name: Weyl 二乗の Ricci の係数を D = 4 の値に固定する
expect_fail: conformal: C'^2 = lam^-4 C^2 for the general-D Weyl square (D = 5)
expect_pass: conformal: C'^2 = lam^-4 C^2 for the general-D Weyl square (D = 4)

mutants.name: 共変微分が最初の添字しか見ない
expect_fail: cov_deriv_lower: Leibniz on a rank-3 product

mutants.name: det_exact が pivot の入れ替えの符号を落とす
expect_fail: det_exact: a pivot swap flips the sign

mutants.name: det_jet が det e の因子を落とす
上付きの Levi-Civita が符号によらない
expect_fail: levi_civita: eps_(01...) = +1 and eps eps = sign(det eta) D! (D = 4, L)
expect_pass: levi_civita: eps_(01...) = +1 and eps eps = sign(det eta) D! (D = 4, E)

mutants.name: 1/det e の微分の符号
pairs: inv_d = np.array([-det_e.d[p] * inv0 * inv0 for p in range(dim)], dtype=object)
inv_d = np.array([det_e.d[p] * inv0 * inv0 for p in range(dim)], dtype=object)
expect_pass: dual_vector: T_(ijk) T^(ijk) = sign(det eta) 3! S_m S^m with the curved measure (L)

mutants.name: solve_exact が矛盾した行を見ない
pairs: consistent = all(sum(a * s for a, s in zip(row, sol)) == b for row, b in zip(rows, rhs))
expect_fail: solve_exact: an inconsistent row is reported
